match: a double cone cut by a plane — conic sections (circle, ellipse, parabola, hyperbola as plane sections); labels like "conic", "cone section", "3d cone", "hình nón", "khối nón", or a cone sketch with a slanted line/plane through it
params: {"flat": true|false — start flattened/unfolded; "slice": true|false — open the slicing plane; "tilt": 0-180, "offset": -1.4..1.4, "spin": 0-360, "cut": "full"|"above"|"below"} — all optional
